facts.statement: Community kart racing event for Summer Camp Racing Week held at the Wildwood Speedway, with a party just outside the race course.
facts.quote: we are gathering at the Wildwood Speedway, just south of the Crossroads Warpstone for some fast and furious kart racing action.

facts.statement: The US/Latin America session was on Thursday July 29, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday July 29th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK/Europe session was on Friday July 30 at 9:00am Pacific (4:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday July 30th 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE's community event post for Summer Camp Racing Week: a kart racing event at the Wildwood Speedway, just south of the Crossroads Warpstone, on Server 1 on Thursday July 29, 2010 (US/Latin America, 3pm Pacific) and Friday July 30 (9:00am Pacific / 4:00pm GMT, UK/Europe). The post also explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.
